name: stock-quote
title: Stock quote
description: A brokerage-style quote panel: ticker, name and trading status, the price in large type with its change in the market's colour, a scrubbable and zoomable price chart with line and candle views, range controls that switch windows on their own, an after-hours line, and a strip of key figures — built for agents streaming live market data into a card or a full-width page.
